title: JFTA-Bench: Evaluate LLM's Ability of Tracking and Analyzing Malfunctions Using Fault Trees
abstract: arXiv:2603.22978v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the maintenance of complex systems, fault trees are used to locate problems and provide targeted solutions. To enable fault trees stored as images to be directly processed by large language models, which can assist in tracking and analyzing malfunctions, we propose a novel textual representation of fault trees. Building on it, we construct a benchmark for multi-turn dialogue systems that emphasizes robust interaction in complex environments, evaluating a model's ability to assist in malfunction localization, which contains $3130$ entries and $40.75$ turns per entry on average. We train an end-to-end model to generate vague information to reflect user behavior and introduce long-range rollback and recovery procedures to simulate user error scenarios, enabling assessment of a model's integrated capabilities in task tracking and error recovery, and Gemini 2.5 pro archives the best performance.

translated_title: JFTA-Bench：评估大语言模型使用故障树追踪和分析故障的能力
translated_abstract: 在复杂系统的维护中，故障树被用于定位问题并提供针对性的解决方案。为了使以图像形式存储的故障树能够被大语言模型直接处理，从而辅助追踪和分析故障，我们提出了一种新颖的故障树文本表示方法。基于此，我们构建了一个面向多轮对话系统的基准测试，强调在复杂环境中的稳健交互，评估模型协助故障定位的能力，该基准包含3130条数据，平均每条数据包含40.75轮对话。我们训练了一个端到端模型来生成模糊信息以模拟用户行为，并引入长程回滚和恢复流程来模拟用户出错场景，从而评估模型在任务追踪和错误恢复方面的综合能力，其中Gemini 2.5 Pro取得了最佳性能。
tldr: 提出故障树的新型文本表示方法及JFTA-Bench基准，通过模拟用户的模糊表达和出错场景，评估大语言模型在多轮对话中协助故障定位时的任务追踪与错误恢复综合能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel textual representation of fault trees and the JFTA-Bench benchmark, which simulates vague user behavior and user error scenarios to evaluate LLMs' integrated capabilities in task tracking and error recovery for malfunction localization in multi-turn dialogues.
